Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. Reports Results for Fiscal Second Quarter 2027
Fiscal second quarter Net Bookings were $1.60 billion
Company updates fiscal year 2027 outlook and reiterates expectation for Net Bookings of $8.0 to $8.2 billion
New York, NY – November 9, 2026 – Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ:TTWO) today reported results for the second quarter of its fiscal year 2027, ended September 30, 2026.
Strauss Zelnick, Chairman and CEO of Take-Two Interactive, stated: “The launch of Grand Theft Auto VI is ten days away and, with pre-orders continuing to reach unprecedented levels, we expect to deliver an historic year for our company. We are reiterating our outlook for Fiscal 2027 Net Bookings of $8 to $8.2 billion, and are confident in our ability to build on this incredible year as we release new hits, explore emerging business opportunities, expand our geographic footprint, and pursue accretive M&A – all of which will set us on a path to unlock greater earnings power and long-term shareholder value.”
Total Net Bookings* decreased 18% to $1.60 billion compared to $1.96 billion during last year’s fiscal second quarter.
GAAP net revenue was $1.50 billion, compared to $1.77 billion in last year’s fiscal second quarter.
